1932, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Clifton Wms. 42 - in Eloise Hospital - nervous.
Doraine Innes - 8 - of Montreal - at 4 had maninjitis of brain - then paralysis and curviture of spine & crosseyed. Enrolled in 1930. Since that day of enrollment has been able to walk without crutches.
Albina Bogedin - 25 - lost finger - now blood poison threatens hand - has husband & little Son - 11 mo. old sick
Aug. Formiller neglecting wife & 2 Ch. Mrs. Minnie Hall - non Cath - 55 - vericose veins Baby Fetzer - 2 mo. - born without eyes - just empty lids. Mary McDonough -40 - Epyli'y - hives - tongue.
Page 53 July Page 54 July
Albina Waldsch - 17 - mental now St. Joseph's Retreat
Baby Cha's D. Mop - 6 mo. - threatened with kidney trouble - poorly
Geo Treese .... fearing being robbed - left money and jewelry in safe - feared to take it with him on leaving at 4 a.m. where he had to work all night. Robbers from same house, in fact by renter, caught in the attempt to rob safe, now said G. T. is anxious and wife re- quests prayers that everything smoothe off rightly.
Miss Mary R. Cowen - 42 - fell 37 yrs. ago, broke her nose, suffer- ing ever since, now mentally weak - mother asks prayers-
Antonina Tokco - 28 - two small children - has tumor on brain - on way to Mayo Brs.
James Dettloff - 22 - in Kiefer Hosp. Drs. think has T.B. of brain D.K. young man - throat lance this P.M.
Edmond Reno - 58 - cancer of stomach - wife & 7 depending on him. Wanted to come To-day. Could not.
Garland Casey is. Marg. Walsh ... nose.
Page 52 Cont. July 9
